title: Add a semantic label to the icon-only drill-in IconButton in LifetimeMarkingScopeRow
why: This IconButton has no tooltip and isn't wrapped in Semantics, unlike the rest of the batch — progress_tier_counter_row.dart, for example, explicitly wraps its icon+number tiles in Semantics(label: ...). A screen-reader user landing on this control hears an unlabeled button with no indication it drills into the row's children.
recommendation: Add a tooltip (e.g. an l10n 'View details' / drill-in key) to the IconButton.
acceptance_criteria: The IconButton exposes a non-empty accessible label (tooltip or Semantics wrapper), verifiable via a widget test asserting on Semantics data.
